basic_profile.bio: I'm a helicopter enthusiast from Seattle with a soft spot for nostalgic flash games like Strike Force Heroes. When I'm not working as an IT support specialist, I enjoy exploring cozy games on my Nintendo Switch. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my evenings engaging with online communities, especially around topics like aviation and indie music. My weekends are often filled with outdoor activities or catching up on the latest gaming trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in IT, having studied computer science at a local community college. My interest in helicopters stems from a childhood fascination, supplemented by self-taught knowledge through online resources and forums. Additionally, I have a keen interest in gaming, both retro and contemporary, which I've developed over years of playing and community interaction.
